title: Zombie Outbreak: Nobody Answered The Ferry Horn | S1E3
description:
You're trapped forty meters up a water tower with no ladder, no food, and three hundred of them waiting below. Last night, a ferry horn sounded from the harbor.
Now you have to get there: a homemade rope, a raft made of plastic drums, and a river full of things that fell off the bridge.
